hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty' | { read -r f; base=$(basename "$f" 2>/dev/null); case "$base" in .env|.env.*) printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: .env holds live Railway DB credentials and a Facturapi key. Edit it manually outside Claude Code, not through this tool."}}';; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *src/modules/*|*/test/*|test/*) out=$(npm test 2>&1 | tail -c 4000); jq -n --arg out "$out" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("Test run after edit:\n" + $out)}}';; esac; }
